tools.name: list_games
tools.description: Discover Duoly games for teammates and coaching. Use a returned id or slug in find_session.

tools.name: list_services
tools.description: Compare services with plain-language descriptions, from prices in EUR per unit, exact rank and region tokens and bookUrls. Share bookUrl so the user can book on Duoly.

tools.name: find_session
tools.description: Start here to find a player or coach. Returns up to three matching sessions with real calculated prices, descriptions, missing inputs and bookUrls to open Duoly. Use exact game, goal, rank and region tokens; errors list valid choices.

tools.name: get_quote
tools.description: Get a real calculated session price and bookUrl for a selected service. Share bookUrl to review options and pay on Duoly. Base price before account perks.

tools.name: get_availability
tools.description: Check public availability context and positive online counts when available. A teammate accepts from the queue; counts do not guarantee a match.

tools.name: create_booking_link
tools.description: Get a bookUrl that opens Duoly with the game and service selected. Share it for the user to review remaining options and pay on duoly.gg.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_quote, create_booking_link · Private data: list_services, find_session · Public sink: list_services, get_quote, create_booking_link.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_quote, create_booking_link · Private data: list_services, find_session · Public sink: list_services, get_quote, create_booking_link

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
